description:
The Ambubhai Purani Award is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Gujarat. 

This award was established in the year 2014. 

The scheme is named after Ambubhai Purani, a noted social worker and philanthropist. 

The primary objective of the Ambubhai Purani Award is to recognize and honor the contributions of individuals in the field of social service. 

This award aims to encourage social work and inspire others to engage in community service. 

The award is given annually to individuals who have made significant contributions to society. 

The award focuses particularly on those who have worked towards the upliftment of underprivileged communities. 

The scheme emphasizes the importance of social responsibility and community engagement. 

The award includes a monetary component as well as a certificate of recognition. 

The monetary award amount is set at ₹1 lakh. 

In addition to the cash prize, recipients receive a citation that acknowledges their contributions. 

The award is open to individuals from all walks of life. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to be eligible for the award. 

However, candidates must demonstrate a proven track record of social work. 

The eligibility criteria also include a focus on individuals who have worked in Gujarat. 

Applications for the Ambubhai Purani Award can be submitted through the official website of the Gujarat government. 

Interested candidates must fill out an application form available online. 

The application form requires details about the candidate's social work and contributions. 

Applicants must provide supporting documents that validate their claims of social service. 

The application process typically opens in the month of January each year. 

The deadline for submission of applications is usually set for the end of February. 

Once the applications are received, a committee reviews them. 

The committee is composed of experts in social work and community service. 

The selection process is rigorous and aims to ensure that deserving candidates are recognized. 

The award ceremony is usually held in the month of March. 

During the ceremony, the awardees are honored in the presence of dignitaries and government officials. 

The Ambubhai Purani Award serves as a platform to promote social work in Gujarat. 

It encourages individuals to take initiative in addressing social issues. 

The award also aims to create awareness about the importance of community service. 

By recognizing outstanding contributions, the scheme hopes to inspire others to follow suit. 

The Gujarat government actively promotes the award through various channels. 

This includes social media campaigns and public announcements. 

The scheme has been successful in identifying and honoring numerous individuals. 

Many awardees have gone on to further their social initiatives after receiving the award. 

The Ambubhai Purani Award has become a prestigious recognition in the state. 

It has helped to elevate the profile of social work in Gujarat. 

The award also highlights the role of individuals in driving social change. 

The scheme aligns with the broader goals of the Indian government to promote social welfare. 

It contributes to the national agenda of empowering marginalized communities. 

The award has seen participation from various sectors of society. 

This includes NGOs, educational institutions, and grassroots organizations. 

The impact of the award can be seen in the increased engagement in social work. 

Many recipients have leveraged the recognition to secure funding for their initiatives. 

The award has also fostered collaboration among social workers in the state. 

Networking opportunities have arisen from the recognition provided by the award. 

The Ambubhai Purani Award is a testament to the spirit of philanthropy in Gujarat. 

It encourages a culture of giving back to the community. 

The scheme has been instrumental in creating role models for future generations. 

The award serves as a reminder of the importance of social responsibility. 

It emphasizes that every individual can contribute to societal betterment. 

The Gujarat government continues to support and promote the Ambubhai Purani Award. 

The scheme reflects the commitment of the state to uplift its citizens. 

In conclusion, the Ambubhai Purani Award is a significant initiative. 

It recognizes the invaluable contributions of individuals in social service. 

The award not only honors the recipients but also inspires others to engage in community work. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a more equitable society. 

The Ambubhai Purani Award stands as a beacon of hope for many in Gujarat. 

It encourages a collective effort towards social development and welfare. 

The scheme is a vital part of Gujarat's commitment to social justice and community empowerment. 

Overall, the Ambubhai Purani Award is a comprehensive initiative that celebrates social work. 

It plays a crucial role in fostering a culture of altruism and community service in the state.
